BiblicalUsage: Peliliyyah is judicature, the judging itself. Isaiah says the priest and the prophet have erred through wine, they are out of the way through strong drink, they err in vision and stumble in judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe judgment stumbles when the judges are drunk: a priest who cannot see straight cannot judge straight.
